lines.zh: 我只有拇指长，游得比谁都快。
lines.en: I am thumb-length and swim faster than anyone.

lines.zh: 菌丝在头顶织成伞，我在伞下走。
lines.en: Mycelium weaves an umbrella overhead; I travel beneath it.

lines.zh: 熔岩离我三寸，我贴着走。
lines.en: Lava lies three inches off, and I hug the edge.

lines.zh: 五条同伴，像一串小火星。
lines.en: Five schoolmates, like a string of little sparks.

lines.zh: 我穿过一丛诡异菌，菌盖让开。
lines.en: I pass a warped fungus and its cap lifts aside.
The water is too hot, so I beat my tail faster.
I cross an entire sea of lava.

lines.zh: 热菌丝替我挡住了热气。
lines.en: The warm mycelium shields me from the heat.

lines.zh: 我钻进菌柄的缝里歇脚。
lines.en: I duck into a crevice in a fungus stalk to rest.

lines.zh: 九厘米是我的极限，我还小。
lines.en: Nine centimeters is my limit, and I am still small.

lines.zh: 我顺着岩浆的边游成一圈。
lines.en: I trace one lap along the magma's rim.
Black stone ahead; I go around it.
I follow close on a schoolmate's tail.

lines.zh: 一条比我大的鱼让了路。
lines.en: A fish bigger than me gives way.

lines.zh: 岩浆冒泡的地方，我绕开那个泡。
lines.en: Where the lava bubbles, I swim around the bubble.

lines.zh: 一根菌丝垂下来，我从底下穿过。
lines.en: A mycelium thread hangs down, and I pass beneath it.

lines.zh: 同伴少了一条，我回头去找。
lines.en: One of my shoal is missing; I turn back to look.

lines.zh: 热浪推着我，我借它省点力。
lines.en: The heat wave pushes me, and I let it do the work.

lines.zh: 我停在菌丝底下，喘口气。
lines.en: I stop beneath the mycelium to catch my breath.

lines.zh: 熔岩的光把菌丝照成紫色。
lines.en: Lava light turns the mycelium purple.
I am small, and the world is large.

lines.zh: 一段菌丝落下来，我躲开。
lines.en: A strand of mycelium falls and I dodge it.

lines.zh: 我听自己的心跳，一下一下。
lines.en: I listen to my own pulse, beat by beat.

lines.zh: 只有一点血，我活得很小心。
lines.en: With one point of life, I live carefully.

lines.zh: 一个气泡从嘴边浮上去。
lines.en: A bubble drifts up from my mouth.
Far off, the magma slowly turns over.
Schoolmates press close to share warmth.

lines.zh: 我不动，像一粒紫色的沙。
lines.en: I keep still, like a grain of purple sand.
Hot wind rattles the fungus caps.

lines.zh: 我在想上面的世界有没有水。
lines.en: I wonder whether the world above has water.
My fins are too small to make a sound.
When it cools a little, I will swim again.

lines.zh: 我抬头，你大得像一座山。
lines.en: I look up; you are as big as a hill.

lines.zh: 你的靴子踩碎了一丛菌。
lines.en: Your boots crush a patch of fungus.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的桶，桶里有水。
lines.en: I stare at your bucket; there is water inside.

lines.zh: 你弯下腰，影子盖住了我。
lines.en: You stoop, and your shadow swallows mine.
I watch you through a gap in the mycelium.

lines.zh: 你的手伸过来，比我还长。
lines.en: Your hand comes near, longer than I am.
I do not fear you; I fear your net.
Firelight is mirrored in your eyes.

lines.zh: 我看见你腰间挂着的小桶。
lines.en: I see the little bucket hanging at your waist.

lines.zh: 你眨眼，我趁机退了一寸。
lines.en: You blink, and I back off an inch.

lines.zh: 一下就够，我只有一点血。
lines.en: One hit is enough; I have a single point.

lines.zh: 你的手指就把我按住了。
lines.en: Your finger alone pins me down.
The pain sends me crashing into stone.
Two scales come off, and I mourn them.
This small wound is heavy for me.

lines.zh: 我侧躺着漂，随即翻回来。
lines.en: I drift on my side, then right myself.
My blood spreads in the water, very little.
I shrink into the mycelium, shaking.
One more touch and I am gone.
I am still alive, which is not easy.
The bait you set is bigger than I am.

lines.zh: 那点碎鱼的香味飘过来了。
lines.en: The scent of fish scraps drifts over.
I move half an inch closer, then stop.
The water sloshing in your bucket sounds lovely.
I know there is a hook, and still want a look.

lines.zh: 菌丝那边更暖，我偏要过去。
lines.en: The mycelium is warmer, yet I go the other way.
The little worm twists on the hook.
My schoolmates hold back; I do not.

lines.zh: 三圈下来，我还是盯着饵。
lines.en: Three slow laps around the bait, no more.
Just one small bite; it should be fine.

lines.zh: 你一脚踩下，我被水推开。
lines.en: You stomp down and the water shoves me aside.

lines.zh: 我的身体撞上你的脚踝。
lines.en: My body bumps against your ankle.
A schoolmate hits me and I spin half a turn.

lines.zh: 你的网兜擦过我的尾巴。
lines.en: Your net grazes my tail.

lines.zh: 我太小，你根本没碰到我。
lines.en: I am so small you never touch me.

lines.zh: 被这么一撞，我差点晕过去。
lines.en: That knock nearly makes me faint.

lines.zh: 我在你指缝之间钻过去。
lines.en: I slip between your fingers.

lines.zh: 鱼群一挤，我被推到岩边。
lines.en: The school squeezes me against the rock.
I hit a fungus stalk and bounce back.
Not so hard; I am only a finger long.
She is half a centimeter shorter than me.
We swim side by side under the fungus cap.

lines.zh: 她的颜色像暮色里的紫。
lines.en: Her color is the purple of dusk.
I trace slow rings around her, fins aquiver.

lines.zh: 五条同伴替我们让出地方。
lines.en: Five schoolmates make room for us.
The hot current pushes us together.
She touches my side fin.
Our eggs are smaller than grains of sand.
I hide them deep inside the mycelium.

lines.zh: 这里太热，孩子会自己活。
lines.en: It is too hot here; the young will manage on their own.

lines.zh: 我叼起一粒发光的孢子。
lines.en: I pick up a glowing spore.
I clamp your bait and hold on.
Too heavy; it drags me sideways.
Holding it, I cannot swim fast.
The bucket is too tall to jump into.

lines.zh: 钩子含在嘴里，我吐不出。
lines.en: The hook sits in my mouth and will not come out.

lines.zh: 我用嘴推了推一片菌屑。
lines.en: I nudge a bit of fungus with my mouth.
Iron taste in my mouth makes me shake my head.
I hold it briefly, then let it go.
You reach out; I dive into the mycelium.
The water stirs and my head comes up at once.

lines.zh: 你踩碎菌丝的声音太响。
lines.en: The crunch of fungus under your boots is loud.

lines.zh: 我看见一根细线垂下来。
lines.en: I see a thin line dangling down.
The whole school dives into the fungus.
A shadow comes down from above.
That is not the glow of lava.
I aim my eyes at the hook's point.
I press against the stalk and freeze.
The danger is ten times my size.
I hide first and think later.
I watch it from behind the mycelium.
The line is being drawn in slowly.

lines.zh: 我数着钩子晃动的次数。
lines.en: I count how often the hook sways.
One bite and I am finished.
I approach along the edge of the hot current.
I wait for the moment your hand stops.
I keep my tail low and inch forward.
It is two inches away, very close.
My gills are almost closed.
Closer and I bite, then run.
I bite the hook's shank and pull hard.
My tail flicks your finger.

lines.zh: 我撞你的手背，没什么用。
lines.en: I butt your hand, and it does little.
My teeth are small, but they grip.
I shake my head and bend the line.
That bite missed, so I spit and try again.

lines.zh: 我翻腾，把热水甩你一脸。
lines.en: I thrash hot water into your face.
You pinch me and I struggle hard.
Do not squeeze, my bones are like threads.
Let go and I run, very fast.
I open my eyes inside the mycelium.

lines.zh: 熔岩的光第一次照到我。
lines.en: Lava light falls on me for the first time.
Four schoolmates crowd in to sniff me.
I am small enough to fit through a needle's eye.
The hot wind spins me in a circle.
I am born here, in the Nether.
The fungus cap shields me from the ash.
I try a tail stroke and wobble.
My colors have not come in yet.

lines.zh: 我不知道自己能活多久。
lines.en: I do not know how long I will live.

lines.zh: 熔岩里长大的我，火不算什么。
lines.en: Raised in lava, fire means little to me.

lines.zh: 从菌盖上摔下来，我晕了。
lines.en: I fall from the fungus cap and black out.

lines.zh: 水太多，我在水里喘不上气。
lines.en: Too much water; I cannot breathe in it.

lines.zh: 爆炸的气浪把我吹出三格。
lines.en: The blast throws me three blocks.

lines.zh: 箭尖擦过我，几乎把我切开。
lines.en: The arrowhead grazes me and nearly splits me open.

lines.zh: 紫光一照，我整条鱼都僵了。
lines.en: Violet light hits and my whole body stiffens.

lines.zh: 三天没吃东西，我游不动了。
lines.en: Three days without food and I cannot swim.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我连影子都没了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and even my shadow is gone.

lines.zh: 虚空把我往下拽，什么也抓不住。
lines.en: The void drags me down and I catch nothing.
